units.source_text: 五十日诞辰，例行献饼仪式。

en.t: On the child's fiftieth day, the customary ceremony of offering rice cakes was held.

units.source_text: 但母夫人已经改了尼装，这仪式应该如何办法呢？

en.t: But since his mother had already taken on a nun's dress, how should this ceremony be handled?

units.source_text: 众侍女正在踌躇不决，源氏来了。

en.t: As the ladies in waiting were hesitating, unable to decide, Genji arrived.

units.source_text: 他说：“这又何妨呢！

en.t: He said, "What harm could there be in that?

units.source_text: 倘是个女孩，则当尼姑的母亲来参与庆典，嫌不吉利；

en.t: If the child were a girl, people might think it unlucky for a mother who had become a nun to take part in the celebration;

units.source_text: 男孩有什么呢！”

en.t: but with a boy, what problem is there?"

units.source_text: 便在南面设一小小座位，给小公子坐了，向他献饼。

en.t: So a small seat was set up on the south side, the young lord was seated there, and rice cakes were offered to him.

units.source_text: 乳母打扮得花枝招展，奉献的礼品种类繁多，

en.t: The wet nurse was dressed in splendid finery, and there were many kinds of gifts to present,

units.source_text: 盛饼饵的笼子、盛食品的盒子，装潢都极美观，帘内帘外都摆满。

en.t: with baskets for rice cakes and boxes for food, all beautifully decorated and filling the space both inside and outside the blinds.

units.source_text: 众人不知道内情，兴致十足地布置着。

en.t: Everyone, unaware of the true circumstances, arranged everything in high spirits.

units.source_text: 源氏看了只觉得伤心，又甚可耻。

en.t: Seeing it, Genji felt only sorrow, and also deep shame.

units.source_text: 三公主也起来了。

en.t: The Third Princess had also risen.

units.source_text: 她的头发末端很密，扩展在两旁。

en.t: The ends of her hair were thick and spread out on both sides.

units.source_text: 她觉得不舒服，用手从额上掠开去。

en.t: Feeling uncomfortable, she brushed it away from her forehead with her hand.

units.source_text: 此时源氏撩起帷屏，走进来了。

en.t: Just then Genji lifted the curtain screen and came inside.

units.source_text: 三公主怕难为情，转向一旁。

en.t: The Third Princess, embarrassed, turned aside.

units.source_text: 她的身子比产前更加瘦小了。

en.t: Her body had grown even thinner and smaller than before the birth.

units.source_text: 那头发因为可惜，那天落发时留得很长，所以后面是否剪落，不大看得清楚。

en.t: Because her hair had seemed too precious to cut, it had been left very long on the day of her tonsure, so it was hard to tell clearly whether the back had been cut off.

units.source_text: 她穿着一件袖口上和裾上层层重叠的淡墨色衬衣，

en.t: She wore a pale ink colored underrobe whose cuffs and hems lay in many overlapping layers,

units.source_text: 外加一件带黄的淡红色衫子。

en.t: and over it a pale red robe with a yellowish tint.

units.source_text: 她这尼装还不曾穿惯。

en.t: She was not yet used to this nun's attire.

units.source_text: 从侧面望去，这样打扮也很美观，像个孩子模样，玲珑可爱。

en.t: Seen from the side, this dress was beautiful too; she looked childlike, delicate, and lovely.

units.source_text: 源氏说道：“唉，我真难过啊！

en.t: Genji said, "Ah, this is truly painful for me.

units.source_text: 淡墨色到底不好，教人看了觉得眼前黑暗。

en.t: Pale ink color is no good after all; it makes everything look dark to the eyes.

units.source_text: 我曾安慰自己：你虽然做了尼姑，我还可常常见你。

en.t: I once consoled myself by thinking that although you had become a nun, I could still see you often.

units.source_text: 然而眼泪始终淌个不住，实甚可厌。

en.t: Yet my tears keep flowing without end, which is truly wretched.

units.source_text: 我今被你舍弃，然世人认为罪归于我，这也使我痛心万分，苦恨无限！

en.t: Now I have been abandoned by you, yet the world thinks the blame lies with me, and that too causes me unbearable pain and endless bitterness.

units.source_text: 可惜不能回复从前旧状了。”

en.t: It is a pity that things can never return to the way they were before."

units.source_text: 他叹息一声，又说：“倘你说现已出家为尼，故欲与我离居，

en.t: He sighed once, then said again, "If you say that, because you have now taken vows as a nun, you wish to live apart from me,

units.source_text: 这便是你真心厌弃我，使我觉得可耻可悲。

en.t: then it means you truly despise and reject me, and it makes me feel both ashamed and sad.

units.source_text: 还望你怜爱我些。”

en.t: I still hope you will show me a little pity and affection."

units.source_text: 三公主答道：“我闻出家之人，不懂得世俗怜爱。

en.t: The Third Princess replied, "I have heard that those who leave the world do not understand worldly affection.

units.source_text: 何况我本来不懂，教我如何奉答呢？”

en.t: Besides, I never understood it to begin with, so how am I to answer you?"

units.source_text: 源氏说：“那就无可奈何了。

en.t: Genji said, "Then there is nothing to be done.

units.source_text: 但你也有懂得的时候吧！”

en.t: But surely there will be times when you do understand."

units.source_text: 他只说了这两句话，便去看小公子。

en.t: After saying only these few words, he went to look at the young lord.
